scope: Nonexperimental review of whether exploration gates are prematurely demanding confirmatory or implementation evidence

conclusion.basis: Purposive document audit against primary methodology and official review guidance; not a causal evaluation of topic-selection outcomes
conclusion.correction: Separate candidate exploration, exploratory diagnosis, and confirmatory implementation; align requirements with contribution type

primary_sources.title: NeurIPS 2026 Reviewing Guidelines
primary_sources.depth: official HTML selected General, Use-Inspired, Concept and Feasibility, Negative Results sections
primary_sources.supports: Contribution-specific interpretation; originality need not be a new method; concept and negative results still have high significance and evidence requirements

primary_sources.title: NeurIPS Evaluations & Datasets 2026 Reviewing Guidelines
primary_sources.depth: official HTML Benchmark Design and Analysis, Evaluation Methodology and Metrics, Auditing sections
primary_sources.supports: Changed scientific conclusions under evaluation assumptions can be a contribution; beating a baseline is not required for these types; rigor remains required

primary_sources.title: ECCV 2026 Guidance to Reviewers on Contribution Types
primary_sources.depth: official HTML introduction, Applied/Systems, Concept and Feasibility
primary_sources.supports: Do not apply one rigid checklist; meaningful small feasibility validation may support appropriately scoped concept work

primary_sources.title: ICLR 2026 Reviewer Guide
primary_sources.depth: official HTML reviewing questions and SOTA/contemporaneous-work FAQ
primary_sources.supports: New useful knowledge need not achieve SOTA; this venue/year has explicit contemporaneous and arXiv comparison boundaries
primary_sources.limit: Not a universal rule for other venues or permission to conceal known related work

primary_sources.title: Foundations of Computer Vision: How to Do Research
primary_sources.authors: Antonio Torralba, Phillip Isola, William Freeman
primary_sources.supports: Toy models build intuition; failure localization and nearby revisions can generate progress; related literature still matters

primary_sources.title: The preregistration revolution
primary_sources.authors: Brian A. Nosek, Charles R. Ebersole, Alexander C. DeHaven, David T. Mellor
primary_sources.depth: primary publisher/PMC search-indexed abstract and Program of Research passages
primary_sources.access_boundary: Direct publisher open returned 403; PMC direct open returned access-check page; no local PDF
primary_sources.supports: Exploratory hypothesis generation and confirmatory testing are distinct and iterative; discoveries should not be reported as prior predictions
primary_sources.limit: No blanket preregistration requirement imposed on this repository

primary_sources.title: How To Choose a Good Scientific Problem
primary_sources.depth: author-hosted primary search-indexed Two Dimensions of Problem Choice passage and lab publication metadata
primary_sources.access_boundary: Web PDF open timed out; no local PDF
primary_sources.supports: Interest or expected new knowledge and feasibility are separate axes, weighted by researcher circumstances

primary_sources.title: A Survival Guide to a PhD
primary_sources.supports: Problem taste develops through practice and apprenticeship; an important problem also needs a plausible attack

source_limits: Official reviewer guidelines describe finished submissions, not mandatory initial-idea gates
Advice and methodology are not causal evidence that the revised workflow raises acceptance rates
Only selected primary passages were reviewed; not all historical guide sources were rechecked
Third-party lists, search mirrors, Reddit and acceptance predictions were not used as final authority

case_audit.preserve: No new-theory claim from algebra; task and controller confounding; current NO-GO/HOLD
case_audit.correct_future_interpretation: A rank-change identity does not establish that empirical prevalence, magnitude, or scope are trivial; evaluation discovery need not start with a causal mechanism

case_audit.preserve: Conditional sufficiency under correct grounding/tracking; current NO-GO/HOLD
case_audit.correct_future_interpretation: Conditional sufficiency is not measured reliability of those assumptions; baseline existence is not empirical sufficiency

case_audit.preserve: Specific novelty claims excluded by direct prior; existing HOLD
case_audit.correct_future_interpretation: Same method family does not eliminate all question or condition differences

case_audit.preserve: Actual bounded pilot failed prespecified joint gate; no post-hoc rescue or automatic restart
case_audit.correct_future_interpretation: Do not generalize this negative result to all navigation questions

operational_changes: Stage-appropriate entry requirements in existing buildup guide
Five-field exploratory card; expanded implementation template is optional until relevant
Allow direction-agnostic empirical questions and hypothesis generation
Distinguish direct collision, logical contradiction, negative evidence, prioritization, unknowns and resource waiting
Contribution-type-specific assessment; no universal new-method or mechanism requirement
GAP-S3 remains next but uses exploratory entry criteria
